result:
Users can now edit their own comments. I haven't run tests, lint or the app, as you asked. The last lint hook error (about `useNotifications` in the component) was stale, because the import was already gone when I checked.

- **API:** `features/comments/api/update-comment.ts` sends `PATCH /comments/{commentId}` with the new body, validated by a Zod schema. On success it refreshes the comments list and shows a "Comment Updated" notification. The lint rule says success notifications belong in the api hook, so the notification is in the hook and not in the component, unlike the create and delete comment components.
- **UI:** `features/comments/components/update-comment.tsx` adds an "Edit Comment" button that opens a form drawer pre-filled with the current body.
- **Own comments only:** I added a `comment:update` policy in `lib/authorization.tsx` that allows only the comment's author. The Edit button is wrapped in it in `comments-list.tsx`, next to Delete. Admins can delete any comment but only edit their own.
- **Mock API:** I added a PATCH handler to the MSW comments handlers, so the edit works against the mock backend. It only updates comments authored by the current user.
